UnitDefinition.Name: Bioaccessibility fraction variability distribution types.
UnitDefinition.Description: Supported distribution types for specifying substance bioaccessibility fractions (variability) distributions.

Unit.Name: LogNormal
Unit.Description: Lognormal distribution parameterised by a mean and a coefficient of variation.

Unit.Name: Uniform
Unit.Description: Uniform distribution specified by a mean/median and a coefficient of variation.
